description: Return every name you've bound this session, as a list of entries. Each entry has the name you chose, the kind ('object', 'sim', or 'location'), the bound target (target_object_id / target_sim_id / x,y,level), and any note you attached. Useful to check your private map of the world and to decide whether a name still points somewhere meaningful. If you get no results on a go-to --my_name you expected to work, list-names is where you confirm what you actually have.
call_signatures: cf $CF list-names     # list all current name bindings
perception_hints: list-names is the source of truth for what your private name map contains; nothing else in perception mirrors it.
